units.source_text: 我搬到现在这所住宅，是在那以后不久。

en.t: It was not long after that that I moved into my present house.

units.source_text: 夫人和小姐都忌讳以前那所房子，

en.t: Both Madam and the young lady dreaded the former house,

units.source_text: 我也是每晚都重复着那夜的回忆，不堪其苦，

en.t: and I too was tormented each night by the recurring memory of that evening,

units.source_text: 所以大家商量后，便决定搬家。

en.t: so after discussing it together, we decided to move.

units.source_text: 搬过去约莫过了两个月，我顺利地从大学毕业了。

en.t: About two months after we moved, I graduated safely from the university.

units.source_text: 毕业后还不到半年，我终于跟小姐结了婚。

en.t: Less than half a year after graduation, I finally married the young lady.

units.source_text: 从表面上看，一切都如愿以偿，自然可喜可贺。

en.t: Seen from the outside, everything had gone just as I wished, and it was naturally a matter for celebration.

units.source_text: 无论夫人还是小姐，都沉浸在幸福中，我也觉得很幸福。

en.t: Both Madam and the young lady were immersed in happiness, and I too felt happy.

units.source_text: 但是，我的幸福却伴随着一道阴影，

en.t: But my happiness was accompanied by a shadow,

units.source_text: 我想，这幸福莫非就是最终把我引向那悲剧命运的导火索吧。

en.t: and I thought that perhaps this happiness was the very fuse that would finally lead me toward that tragic fate.

units.source_text: 结婚的时候，小姐——已经不是小姐了，应该称为妻子——妻子不知怎么突然说：

en.t: At the time of our marriage, the young lady, who was no longer the young lady and should be called my wife, suddenly said for some reason:

units.source_text: ‘我们去给K扫扫墓吧。’

en.t: Let us go and visit K's grave.

units.source_text: 我不由心头一惊，问她怎么忽然想起这个来了。

en.t: I was startled in spite of myself and asked her what had suddenly made her think of that.

units.source_text: 妻说：‘我们一起去扫墓，K一定会高兴的。’

en.t: My wife said, If we go to visit his grave together, K will surely be pleased.

units.source_text: 我直勾勾地盯着一无所知的妻子的脸，

en.t: I stared fixedly at the face of my wife, who knew nothing,

units.source_text: 直到妻子问我怎么了，才清醒过来。

en.t: and only came to my senses when she asked me what was wrong.

units.source_text: 我答应了妻子的要求，两个人一同到杂司谷去了。

en.t: I agreed to my wife's request, and the two of us went together to Zoshigaya.

units.source_text: 我在K的新墓上洒了洗尘水，

en.t: I poured cleansing water over K's new grave,

units.source_text: 妻子在墓碑前供上线香和鲜花。

en.t: and my wife placed incense sticks and fresh flowers before the gravestone.

units.source_text: 我们低下头合掌祈祷。

en.t: We bowed our heads, pressed our palms together, and prayed.

units.source_text: 妻子想必是在报告和我结婚的前后经过，想让K也高兴高兴吧，

en.t: My wife must have been reporting how she had come to marry me, hoping to make K happy too,

units.source_text: 我只是在心里一遍遍重复着：‘是我对不起你。’

en.t: while I merely repeated over and over in my heart: It was I who wronged you.
